articles.title: Traders' hopes fade for U.S.-Iran nuclear deal this year despite report on potential ceasefire agreement
articles.description: Chances of a nuclear deal between the U.S. and Iran this year haven't moved much on prediction markets after Axios reported that the two agreed to a ceasefire.

articles.title: Iran reportedly launches missiles as Trump mulls deal to pause war for two months
articles.description: The latest military and economic actions come as President Trump insists he feels no pressure to make a deal with Iran before November's midterm elections.

articles.title: Rebuilding US weapons stockpile may ‘take years’ post-Iran war
articles.description: Restoring pre-war stockpiles of critical US munitions will take at least two years, according to CSIS report.

articles.title: US Treasury threatens Oman with sanctions over Hormuz Strait
articles.description: US official says Oman should know that Washington 'will aggressively target' actors that facilitate tolls in waterway.

articles.title: Airlines, hotels warn against Trump admin threat to international flights to 'sanctuary cities'
articles.description: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said the Trump administration is considering pulling international flight processing in "sanctuary cities."

articles.title: New York passes Mamdani's pied-a-terre tax. Here's who pays and how much
articles.description: Citadel CEO Ken Griffin became the face of the tax after New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani posted a video in front of Griffin's penthouse apartment.

articles.title: EU fines Temu €200m for allowing sale of illegal products
articles.description: The European Commission says the Chinese-owned online retailer failed to take account of risks from baby toys and faulty chargers sold on its platform.

articles.title: Paul McCartney on playing guitar with Paul Mescal: 'He knew it better than I did!'
articles.description: The music legend on delivering "memory songs" for his 20th solo album, The Boys of Dungeon Lane - and why he's intrigued by the new Beatles biopics.
